hypothesis: M1 mirrored basket shorts improve post-return net PnL over matched cash exits on genuinely future episodes.

timing.activation: Explicit start receipt; first slot next UTC midnight after durable receipt. Never backdate or shift an existing start.
timing.enrolment: No episode if scheduled exit plus receipt deadline exceeds fixed horizon.
timing.late: Record MISSED and never reconstruct an eligible past decision.
timing.warmup: Only pre-slot prices already observed by their grid timestamp. Pre-T0 history warms up the signal, never counts as forward outcome.
timing.eligibility: Primary episode comparison requires at least one positive quantity in the entry snapshot. A fully nonpositive original book is recorded NO_LONG_NO_INTERVENTION, never fabricated as missing or profitable.

arms.BASELINE: Actual original V13 during each eligible six-hour window.
arms.CASH: Close the positive sleeve for six hours; existing nonpositive positions unchanged.
arms.SHORT: Copy same state, invert positive q to negative q, identical initial gross notional. Nonpositive quantities unchanged.

return_rule: Restore both counterfactual arms to actual baseline end quantities, charging combined depth, entry and reentry fees. Same terminal positions and marks.

costs.vwap: Observed aggregate side depth, one consumption for crossing 2q
costs.funding: Verified public settlement rates times held quantity and preceding observed mark at most 1800 seconds old
costs.stress: Additional 20bps on ALL counterfactual turnover, including reentry

evaluation.when: Once after the fixed 90-day horizon; no early success or discretionary extension.
evaluation.primary: Mean paired post-return net USDT difference SHORT minus CASH per complete qualified episode.
secondary: Paired difference under additional 20bps turnover costs
Fees funding turnover attribution and missingness
requirements: All eligible episodes accounted for; any unresolved entry/exit/funding/accounting episode makes conclusion INCONCLUSIVE
Both paired difference and SHORT absolute PnL >0 under frozen stress costs
evaluation.inference: Weekly paired aggregation and block uncertainty; episodes share market regimes. No annualization or claim of scientific validation.
evaluation.safety: Storage/integrity/clock fault pauses intake, preserves history, no simulated action. Technical checks can occur weekly; no parameter selection from interim PnL.

change_control: Any semantic parameter or source change after start needs a new version and future boundary; preserve consumed observations.
